youtube.baslik: Once tubes restore hearing, does two-ear listening recover right away? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The masking level difference (MLD) measures how much the threshold in noise improves when the tone phase in one ear is inverted, and it is sensitive to binaural processing in the brainstem. In children who had tubes for middle ear fluid, the MLD was shown to stay small for a while even after hearing returned to normal; studies in adolescence reported that this difference had largely closed.
